verdict.rationale: Docs show compatibility with third-party tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs) and OpenRouter usage appears in community threads, suggesting some ecosystem integration, but there's no evidence of curated community lists, active third-party router/tool maintainers, or a broader ecosystem narrative. missing for 10: curated community lists or awesome-lists, evidence of active third-party maintainers/routers, community-built integrations beyond basic API compatibility, sustained ecosystem engagement metrics.
